question: Can readiness audit hash all artifacts after enabling native target-denial hooks?
design: One process checked immutable cohort identity, then installed target audit hooks and verified two denied roots, then attempted full manifest hashing.

exact_findings.error: Native worker cannot open evaluation targets or labels
exact_findings.cause: The active target-denial hook also blocked final manifest hashing of evaluation/targets.npz.

controls: Guard remained active; no bypass or weakened target-isolation rule.
limitations: Readiness tooling sequencing failure, not a native/model result.
next_decision: Keep this record; hash final artifacts in a fresh non-worker process. Do not alter frozen source or launch native.
